title: Google Opens Preview of Gemini API CLI for Multimodal Generation

tickers.name: Alphabet Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
Developers can now produce audio, video, and images via terminal commands using a new software utility from Google. The Gemini API CLI, currently in preview, allows users to transcribe audio, analyze media, and manage AI agents without requiring SDK scripts, base64 encoding, or extensive curl requests, and it includes a specialized 'Deep Research' feature.

The tool is distributed as a zero-dependency binary and is open source under the Apache-2.0 license. While early users report the tool can generate images in a single command, one tester noted that it misrendered the physical dimensions of Nvidia DGX Spark systems. Industry observers have also distinguished the utility from AI development harnesses such as Claude Code.

selectedTweets.text:
One terminal command, one image. No SDK script, no base64, no docs tab open.

gemini-api image "Create an isometric image for a post on X of a server rack with 8 Nvidia DGX Spark systems (GB10) neatly clustered together" --out .

It nailed the vibe, not the Sparks. Those are much smaller boxes.

The new Gemini API CLI is one zero-dependency binary for text, images, video, TTS, music and Deep Research. Open source under Apache-2.0.
